column4: dialect-gated: the test checks that a scoped read leaves no tenant on a SQL Server pool, on the shipped driver and on one that does not reset, which exists only on SQL Server, and gets its database from testutil.TestDB, which skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is unset (cleat#3678). test-go/commands runs cmd/cleat-worker with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so it skips whole there: 1 skip, measured 2026-11-07, and again on this change, by running it with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set and reading the skip name. Its subtests run, and pass, with CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set.
